positions.name: CalibrationGroundedInReferenceVerification
positions.frame: what grounds a calibration claim — assertion alone, or verification against an external reference standard?
positions.why: Both expressions state the calibration value and immediately ground it in verification against the June reference plates rather than resting on assertion alone — a shared move of subordinating the instrument's output to an external standard, read the same way flatly and without hedge (register: technical/matter-of-fact; power: expert/rational-persuasion; relational: authority-ranking). No tension: both consistently ground rather than merely assert.
